resources.string: Gentle reminders based on your own routine

DhinaSuthra uses location in the background, including when the app is closed or not in use, to recognize recurring places, understand travel between places, learn your daily routine, calculate time spent in different contexts, and provide routine reminders.\n\nYour location history is processed and stored locally on your device. DhinaSuthra does not sell or share your location with advertisers, and the core app has no internet access at all.
